stepTitle: blank (i): Find the value of $$\theta_0$$ that minimizes the objective function.
stepBody: Sammie wants to find the optimal solution for $$\theta_0$$ with respect to the objective function below.\n$$L(\theta_0,\theta_1)=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\frac{\theta_0}{4\theta_1}+\theta_1x_i)**{2}$$
